items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: That was one next to Albert. Then Al.

ctx.x: That's fantastic. Yeah. Now, how many brothers are there in all?

Well, all I know is it was six of us living. It was four dead. I don't know anything about them, see? It was before my time. We had the youngest brother. He was 40. That was the youngest brother. He was 42 years old, I think. That was one next to Albert. Then Al. Then next is Andrew. And next is me. And the next was Robert. And the next was Sam, you see?
Well, what about the youngest? Did he play music at all? No, no.
